## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds statutory logic/tool)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Statutory / Regulatory Compliance Check
- [ ] Follows ICAI Standards on Auditing / Indian Tax Laws
- [ ] Does not transmit any client data externally (100% Offline Principle)
- [ ] Passes automated test suite (`npm run test:all`)
- [ ] Passes linter (`npm run lint`)
